page.layout: One printed page of text, set in the upper half of the page with blank space below. Show-through from the reverse side (the faint lines lower right and the "IN REGINAM MATREM" heading) is not transcribed.

l.i: Sed quid miremur, si rursus amica luto sus
Suauiter in cæno lota semel iaceat?

p.i: Versus numeralis, annum & diem cædis nefanda Amira-lii indicans.
Bartholomæus flet, quia Gallicus occubat Atlas.

page.notes: The first line reads "luto sus" with a long-s form; transcribed as "sus". The woodcut-style initial B of "Bartholomæus" is taken as the first letter of the word. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is present in the lower right and was left out.
